newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - prices end flat to down 1/4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - prices end flat to down 1/4.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices ended unchanged to 1/4 weaker amid strong new issue pricing, particularly on high-grade competitive deals, market sources said.

"Close to zero," price change occurred in the secondary market, one trader said, adding that muni cash ended largely unchanged despite a bond-friendly January consumer price index report. The muni market continues to suffer from lack of activity and supply, he said.
A municipal analyst pegged high-grade issues unchanged, but saw weakness in dollar bonds, which he said ended down 1/8 to 1/4 point.
In the government market, the U.S. Treasury's 30-year bond ended down 13/32 at 100-19/32 to yield 6.58 percent. One trader said the bond's slip was of little concern.
"Treasuries aren't really down very much, they are just kind of wallowing around," he said, citing the bond's recent rally.

"It was trading back at a 6.90 a couple months ago, and now it's trading up at a 6.50, and I think it wants to take a breather," the trader said. "The market has already priced in the fact that the inflation numbers are good, now it's trying to deal with where is the economy."
The Labor Department reported that CPI rose just 0.1 percent, less than the 0.3 percent increase economists had expected.
In debt futures, the March municipal contract closed down 6/32 at 117-24/32. The March T-bond contract closed down 7/32 at 113-20/32. The MOB spread was 132 ticks.

Turning to new issues, Bear Stearns & Co said it repriced $271 million State Public Works Board of the State of California lease revenue refunding bonds, adjusting coupons throughout the offering. The top yield remained 5.65 percent in 2016.
Also Wednesday, Smith Barney Inc repriced $249 million Hempstead Industrial Development Agency, N.Y., bonds, raising the top yield in 2009 to 5.18 percent from 5.15 percent.

In competitive action, Lehman Brothers captured $189.8 million Florida Board of Education bonds. Lehman won the full faith and credit State Board of Education capital outlay bonds with a true interest cost of 5.077 percent.
